/seo/title.source_en: Busan Private Cruise Shore Excursion | AtoC Korea

/seo/pageTitle.source_en: Busan Private Car Charter for Cruise Shore (8hr) | AtoC Korea

/seo/description.source_en: Private Busan cruise shore excursion with port pickup and drop-off, flexible route planning, and a private guide/vehicle planned around your ship schedule.

/seo/metaDescription.source_en: 8-hour fully customizable Busan private car charter for cruise passengers. English-speaking driver, on-time return planned, hotel/KTX/cruise port pickup.

/hero/tagline.source_en: From ⟦G0⟧ to ⟦G1⟧ cliffs to Gamcheon's painted alleys to Jagalchi's working harbor — eight private hours, your route, your pace, with return planned around your ship time.

/catalog_card/title.source_en: Busan Cruise Shore: Private Car Charter

/catalog_card/subtitle.source_en: A private Busan shore day with cruise-port pickup, flexible sightseeing, and a route planned around your ship’s arrival and all-aboard time.

/catalog_card/priceLabel.source_en: From US$359 per vehicle (was $379, 1–6 pax, 8h) · 7–12 pax 2× · 13+ pax 3×

/catalog_card/shortCardDescription.source_en: A private Busan shore excursion for cruise guests. Choose the places that matter most — ⟦G2⟧, Cheongsapo, Blue Line Park, ⟦G1⟧, ⟦G0⟧, Songdo, Nampo-dong, ⟦G3⟧, and more — then adjust the day with your guide around your ship schedule.

/pickup_dropoff/notes/0.source_en: This is a cruise shore-excursion product — pickup is at the cruise terminal, not a hotel. Hotel pickup is not offered on this SKU; for hotel-based pickup, see our separate private Busan day-charter.

/pickup_dropoff/dropoff_points/0/name.source_en: Back to your originating cruise terminal (Yeongdo or Choryang)

/pickup_dropoff/dropoff_points/0/note.source_en: Return planned around your ship's posted departure time. On-time return is guaranteed — we have never missed a sail-away across 4 seasons of cruise charters.

/pickup_dropoff/dropoff_points/0/approx_.source_en: ≈ 90 min before your ship's all-aboard call

/pickup_dropoff/meeting_points/0/name.source_en: Busan International Cruise Terminal (영도 크루즈항 — Dongsam, Yeongdo)

/pickup_dropoff/meeting_points/0/note.source_en: Primary terminal for large cruise ships. Driver waits at the arrival hall with an 'AtoC Korea' sign — please share your cruise name and docking timeline at booking.

/pickup_dropoff/meeting_points/1/name.source_en: Busan Port International Passenger Terminal (부산항국제여객터미널 — Choryang)

/pickup_dropoff/meeting_points/1/note.source_en: Secondary terminal for smaller cruise ships and ferries. Driver waits at the arrival hall with an 'AtoC Korea' sign — please share your cruise name and docking timeline at booking.

/sticky_booking_bar/note.source_en: Select your date and group size to check live availability and complete your booking.

/practicalAccordionItems/0/content/0.source_en: Pickup at Busan Port International Cruise Terminal (Dongsam-dong) for large ships, or International Passenger Terminal (Choryang) for smaller vessels — whichever terminal your ship uses.

/practicalAccordionItems/0/content/1.source_en: The 8-hour service time is planned around your specific all-aboard time, not a fixed clock.

/practicalAccordionItems/0/content/2.source_en: Return drop-off at the same terminal, minimum 60 minutes before your all-aboard time.

/practicalAccordionItems/0/preview.source_en: Pickup at Busan Port cruise terminal; return 60 min before all-aboard

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/0.source_en: Included: private vehicle (sedan, SUV, or van based on group size), licensed English-speaking driver-guide, fuel, tolls, parking.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/content/1.source_en: Excluded: all site admissions (most Busan stops are free), lunch (~₩10,000–20,000), Gamcheon stamp-tour map (₩2,000), ⟦G0⟧ Danubi Train (₩4,000), Busan Tower observatory (₩12,000), tips.

/practicalAccordionItems/1/preview.source_en: Private vehicle, licensed driver-guide, fuel and tolls included

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/1.source_en: You can swap or add stops (e.g., ⟦G0⟧ Temple, Haeundae Beach) up to 24 hours before, subject to time availability.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/content/2.source_en: Guide can also adjust timing within the day to spend more time at your preferred stop.

/practicalAccordionItems/2/preview.source_en: Route can be adjusted up to 24 hours before departure

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/0.source_en: Sedan (up to 3 guests), SUV/MPV (up to 5), or van (up to 8–10) — vehicle type assigned based on group size at booking.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/1.source_en: No other passengers share the vehicle; the day runs entirely around your group's schedule.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/content/2.source_en: All vehicles are air-conditioned with USB charging.

/practicalAccordionItems/3/preview.source_en: Fully private vehicle — no other passengers

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/0.source_en: If your ship diverts or cancels the Busan port call, notify us immediately for a full refund.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/1.source_en: Light rain: tour operates as normal. Typhoon-force weather: full refund or reschedule.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/content/2.source_en: ⟦G0⟧ cliff trail closes in heavy rain; the Danubi Train continues operating.

/practicalAccordionItems/4/preview.source_en: Free cancellation if your ship can't dock; light rain operates as normal

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/0.source_en: Driver-guide speaks fluent English; Korean-English bilingual service available on request.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/1.source_en: ⟦G0⟧'s hillside alleys are not wheelchair-accessible and stroller-difficult.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/content/2.source_en: ⟦G0⟧ Danubi Train (₩4,000) is a good alternative to the cliff walk for mobility-limited guests.

/practicalAccordionItems/5/preview.source_en: English-speaking driver-guide; some stops not wheelchair-accessible
